title: "unstable": ["no-legacy-abort"] in deno.json is accepted but does not enable --unstable-no-legacy-abort
verification_plan: Install deno 2.9.4. Create a minimal deno.json with `{"unstable": ["no-legacy-abort"]}` and a test script that calls `Deno.serve`. Run without `--unstable-no-legacy-abort` CLI flag and verify the deprecation warning does NOT appear (confirming the config entry is wired). Then add the feature name to the wrong config parsing path and re-run to confirm the fix works. Run `cargo test` in the cli crate for regressions.

history.note: Triaged from 72-hour window. Bug: the `no-legacy-abort` unstable feature name works via CLI flag but is not wired in the deno.json config unstable list parsing path despite being recognized as a valid feature name. Config parsing fix in cli/args/mod.rs.
Claimed by dragonfly/deepcode-flash. PR slot reserved for 2026-07-25.
